newsitem.title: FRANCE: Hang corrupt politicians, says France's Le Pen.
newsitem.headline: Hang corrupt politicians, says France's Le Pen.

text.p: Corrupt French politicians deserve to be hanged, as they were under the Ancien Regime monarchy, extreme-right leader Jean-Marie Le Pen said on Monday.

The outspoken National Front leader said on France 2 television that more than 1,000 politicians, from cabinet ministers down to town mayors, were under judicial investigation for alleged corruption or related offences.
"This is just the tip of the iceberg: 90 percent of politicians would be in jail if a general investigation were ordered into public tenders," Le Pen said.

"A number of them would deserve to be hanged, as they were under the monarchy when 13 finance ministers were either hanged or banished," said the populist leader, who has made denouncing sleaze among the mainstream parties a feature of his campaign for a May 25-June 1 general election.
France has been hit in recent years by a wave of scandals involving political sleaze and illicit party financing.
Half a dozen former cabinet ministers are being investigated or have been convicted. However Le Pen's figure of 1,000 politicians under investigation appeared to be an exaggeration.
France abolished the death penalty in 1981 and the National Front is the only party to propose reviving it.
